mapper.sql: CASE WHEN d.total_amount <> 0 THEN i.amount / d.total_amount WHEN d.total_qty <> 0 THEN i.qty / d.total_qty ELSE 0 END
(CASE WHEN (d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' AND d.freight_bearer = 'COMPANY') OR d.kind = 'SALES_RETURN' THEN d.freight ELSE 0 END)

LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_id, SUM(discount_amount * (amount - tax_amount) / amount) AS amount FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR' AND source_type IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN', 'SALES_FREIGHT', 'SALES_RETURN_FREIGHT') AND discount_amount <> 0 AND amount <> 0 GROUP BY source_id) sd ON sd.source_id = d.id

LEFT JOIN (SELECT source_id, SUM(bad_debt_amount * (amount - tax_amount) / amount) AS amount FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR' AND source_type = 'SALES_OUT' AND bad_debt_amount <> 0 AND amount <> 0 GROUP BY source_id) bd ON d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' AND bd.source_id = d.id

LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.doc_id, f.material_id, SUM(f.cost_amount) AS amount, SUM(f.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock_flow f WHERE f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND f.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND f.doc_id IN (SELECT fd.wms_doc_id FROM scm_trade_doc fd WHERE fd.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND fd.biz_date >= #{begin} AND fd.biz_date <= #{end}) GROUP BY f.doc_id, f.material_id) fc ON fc.doc_id = d.wms_doc_id AND fc.material_id = i.material_id

SELECT
d.partner_id AS "groupKey", c.name AS "groupName", t.period AS "groupKey", CAST(t.period AS CHAR) AS "groupName", i.material_id AS "groupKey", CONCAT(m.code, ' ', m.name) AS "groupName",
SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN i.qty ELSE -i.qty END) AS "qty", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * (i.amount - i.tax_amount)) AS "revenue", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * ) AS "discount", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * i.qty * COALESCE(fc.amount / NULLIF(fc.qty, 0), m.ref_cost, 0)) AS "cost", SUM(CASE WHEN fc.amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "missingCost", SUM(COALESCE(bd.amount, 0) * ) AS "badDebt", SUM( * ) AS "freight", SUM(COALESCE(sd.amount, 0) * ) AS "settleDiscount" FROM scm_trade_doc_item i JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id JOIN (SELECT id, YEAR(biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(biz_date) AS period FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND biz_date >= #{begin} AND biz_date <= #{end}) t ON t.id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = d.partner_id
WHERE 1 = 1 AND d.partner_id = #{customerId} GROUP BY
d.partner_id, c.name t.period i.material_id, m.code, m.name
ORDER BY t.period ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1

SELECT e.voucher_id AS "voucherId", a.code AS "accountCode", e.debit AS "debit", e.credit AS "credit" FROM fin_voucher_entry e JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.period >= #{begin} AND v.period <= #{end} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher_entry ce JOIN fin_account ca ON ca.id = ce.account_id WHERE ce.voucher_id = v.id AND ca.code LIKE CONCAT(#{c}, '%')) ORDER BY e.voucher_id, e.seq
